# Beraterium — English site (en.beraterium.de)

> Risk management and business consulting for startups, SMBs and solo self-employed — enterprise methods made accessible.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://en.beraterium.de/): Enterprise risk management for mid-market businesses
- [Services](https://en.beraterium.de/services/): Risk checks for startups, SMBs and solo
- [Method](https://en.beraterium.de/method/): 3-level hazard catalogue, euro-based risk assessment
- [Value guarantee](https://en.beraterium.de/benefit-guarantee/): Three pre-agreed criteria (2 hard, 1 soft) decide — if even one is not met, full refund.
- [Relevance guarantee](https://en.beraterium.de/relevance-guarantee/): If no relevant risk above the agreed threshold is found, the client pays nothing.
- [About](https://en.beraterium.de/about/): Why Beraterium exists
- [Team](https://en.beraterium.de/team/): Founders and experts
- [Risk Radar](https://en.beraterium.de/risk-radar/): Expert network for implementation
- [Blog](https://en.beraterium.de/blog/): Practical risk management insights
- [Contact](https://en.beraterium.de/contact/): Free 30-minute intro call

## Tools (free self-assessments)

- [Tools overview](https://en.beraterium.de/tools/): Free self-assessments drawn from the Beraterium method.
- [Blindspot Check](https://en.beraterium.de/tools/blindspot-check/): Free online self-assessment (10 minutes, no sign-up) for solo self-employed professionals, founders/startups and SMEs. 10–15 "What happens if …" questions about people, technology and day-to-day operations; immediate results with traffic-light status, a risk profile per category and first steps. The check is not a full risk analysis: it covers 15 of more than 100 hazard areas of the 3-level hazard catalog.
